description: Synergi Liquid provides hydraulic models of liquid networks for water utilities and midstream oil operators. DNV describes water-quality and turbidity analysis, flushing sequences, pump operations and the representation of different liquids and specialised equipment. The provider is DNV. Coverage: Coverage follows the network or reservoir supplied by the user. Spatial detail and the simulated time horizon are model settings; there is no fixed observation period. Access: The provider page describes the software and supplies a contact route for access. No executable or example model was obtained. Licence and cost: This is commercial software. The page does not establish the applicable licence agreement or a complete price; access terms must be confirmed with the provider. Limitations: Published capabilities are provider claims. No model was run and numerical accuracy was not independently tested. For infrastructure simulation it supports comparison of operating conditions, network capacity and proposed equipment changes. Related resources: DNV explicitly documents EPANET import and export, connecting this resource to model-epanet.
